entities.summary: Ayo-Maria Atoyebi was a Nigerian Bishop Emeritus of the Roman Catholic Church. He was born in Okerimi–Oro, now in Kwara state, Nigeria and was ordained a priest of Orders of Friars Preachers on 17 December 1978. He served as Bishop of Ilorin Diocese from 6 March 1992 to 11 June 2019.
